confidence_notes: Holistic model estimate, not from live listings or booking pages. Restaurant and drink anchors are moderately reliable for Portuguese tourist-area pricing. Accommodation anchors are less certain and reflect July peak-season pricing on Madeira, which can vary widely by neighbourhood and booking lead time. The FX observation comes from a search snippet of the RBA exchange rates page, not from a direct page read.
comparable_city_reasoning: Priced against mainland Portuguese tourist cities such as Porto and Lisbon, adjusted for Funchal's typically lower restaurant prices and its July high-season accommodation demand on a Atlantic island destination.
